narrative.overview:
The site reads like a developer console that watches the city. One status panel states the verdict (the answer to "ตอนนี้ออกไปได้ไหม"), and six checks run under it as the stages of a pipeline. Dark is the first theme: a graphite ground, panels split by 1px seams, one step of elevation. Light keeps the same grammar on a cool white. There is no glass, no glow, no gradient on content, and no mosaic of equal tiles; the verdict is bigger than everything else on the screen.

Colour carries state and nothing else. Blue means action and "you are here", green/amber/red mean fine/watch/act, grey means no data yet, purple means what belongs to the viewer. Every state also has a shape, so colour is never the only sign. Figures and times are set in a monospaced face so columns line up.

This is a measured build: the home page and the app shell carry the system. Everything below the fold and every other page inherit only the tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first graphite console with a full light twin; the theme follows the device and can be toggled.
Flat: 1px seams and tonal steps, no shadows on panels.
One verdict, six pipeline stages; the check rows with care needed come first on a phone.
State is colour plus glyph shape plus a Thai word.
One looped Thai face for all text, mono for figures only.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only to say fine, watch, act, no data, action, or yours. A surface that needs emphasis uses a seam or the raised step, not a hue.

rules.name: The Honest Grey Rule
rules.body: A check with no data is grey with a dashed ring and the words "รอข้อมูล"; it is never drawn green. The verdict says the data is not all in rather than "ปกติ".

rules.name: The Figures-In-Mono Rule
rules.body: Numbers and times use the mono face with tabular numerals; words never do.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate panels with a 1px seam and, at most, the raised step. A panel that needs a shadow to be seen is placed wrong.

dos: Do put the verdict and its one sentence first on any new top-level screen, with the state glyph beside the word.
Do pair every status colour with its glyph shape and a Thai word.
Do set figures and times in the mono face with `.num`.
Do build new surfaces from seams, the raised step and the `tone-*` classes; reach for the `--c-*` tokens before any Tailwind palette colour.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and body text at 15px or more.
donts: Don't use glass, glow, gradients on content, or soft drop shadows on panels.
Don't colour a surface for decoration; hue means state, action or "yours".
Don't draw a check with missing data as fine.
Don't nest rounded cards inside cards on new work, or use saturated chart bars.
Don't set text below 12px; new work stays at 13px or above.
Don't make the emergency control louder than the verdict; it stays dashed and in the flow of the status panel.
